svg.text: Use isolated copper pads, 2.54 mm pitch, at least 24 columns x 20 rows. Do NOT use connected stripboard.
LOLIN D1 mini V4 / photographed Wiegand reader | proposed build; not bench-tested
Q1: E J6 / B K6 / C L6
Q2: E J16 / B K16 / C L16
No pads are connected by default.
Add the wires on page 4 after soldering
Q1/Q2 must be 2N3904 with the specified E-B-C pin order. Match the supplier's datasheet.
Mark corner A1 in red. Turn the board left-to-right for the solder-side view; keep row 1 at the top.
Q1 flat edge faces row 7; Q2 flat edge faces row 17. Keep all bare component leads separate.
